title: San Diego Vegan Food Tour
blurb:
Eat your way through San Diego! 

People of any diet will enjoy themselves as we indulge on some of the most delicious food in San Diego. On our route we learn about San Diego history and culture.

Food is included in the ticket price.

Meat eaters, vegetarians, vegans and even people who like pineapple on pizza are encouraged to join. (No pineapple on pizza is allowed on the tour!). 

***Please double check the neighborhood and time you are booking***

• DOWNTOWN TOUR: Runs Thursdays and Saturdays at 11:00am. We meet outside the Children's Park on 1st Avenue between Harbor Drive and Island Avenue, on the sidewalk by the dog park. Goes through Marina, Gaslamp Quarter, and East Village. 

• NORTH PARK TOUR: Runs Wednesdays at 6:00pm and Saturdays at 4:30pm. We meet outside Tribute Pizza on the SE corner of Grim Ave and North Park Way. Goes through the North Park neighborhood.
